Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Represents a customer who places food orders, linked to their Google account for authentication.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Customer entity.

googleAccountId.description: Unique identifier provided by the Google authentication system for the customer.

name.description: Full name of the customer as provided in the order form.

email.description: Email address of the customer, used for communication.

phoneNumber.description: Contact phone number or WhatsApp number of the customer.

deliveryAddress.description: The default delivery address for the customer.

MenuItem.title: MenuItem
MenuItem.description: Represents a single food or drink item available on the Ramadhan Takjil menu.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MenuItem entity, often corresponding to the SKU.

name.description: The name of the menu item (e.g., 'Nasi Bakar Ayam').

price.description: The price of the menu item in Indonesian Rupiah (e.g., 12000).

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) for the menu item, used for identification (e.g., RpSKU-1).

category.description: The category of the menu item (e.g., 'Nasi & Lauk', 'Pempek').

vendor.description: The vendor code or ID of this menu item (e.g., 'NL').

stock.description: The current available stock for this menu item.

Vendor.title: Vendor
Vendor.description: Represents a mitra or vendor selling food items.

name.description: Full name or brand of the vendor.

email.description: Email address of the vendor for communication and reports.

phoneNumber.description: Contact phone number or WhatsApp number of the vendor.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a single customer order for Takjil items, including delivery and payment details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Order entity.

customerId.description: Reference to the Customer who placed this order. (Relationship: Customer 1:N Order)

orderDateTime.description: The date and time when the order was placed.

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount of the order, including all items and the delivery fee.

deliveryFee.description: The fixed delivery fee applied to this order (Rp. 2.500).

paymentMethod.description: The chosen payment method for the order.

vendorStatuses.description: A map of vendor codes to their processing status within this order.

deliveryAddress.description: The full delivery address specified for this particular order (copied from customer at order time).

OrderItem.title: OrderItem
OrderItem.description: Represents a specific menu item and its quantity within a larger order.

id.description: Unique identifier for the OrderItem entity.

orderId.description: Reference to the Order this item belongs to. (Relationship: Order 1:N OrderItem)

menuItemId.description: Reference to the MenuItem that was ordered. (Relationship: MenuItem 1:N OrderItem)

quantity.description: The quantity of the specific menu item included in the order.

priceAtOrder.description: The price of the menu item at the time the order was placed, to ensure historical accuracy.

vendor.description: The vendor code for the item at the time of order.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: System configuration settings, such as mail server credentials and inventory defaults.
